samples.speaker: iona
samples.direction: Iona: observant and warm, restrained suspense, precise articulation. Let the discovery land without sounding triumphant. About 125 words per minute.
samples.script: Mara was not taken from Leth. She borrowed the bell key, recovered a removed folio, and followed a record of the old flood toward the pumping works. The tide and the official story disagree by more than a smudged digit.

samples.speaker: rowan
samples.direction: Rowan: older lockkeeper, weathered low delivery, contained remorse and quiet resolve. No theatrical sobbing or added sighs. About 135 words per minute.
samples.script: That I shut the lower footway barrier. That I unfastened it when Tomas called, while he opened the separate upper footway gate. That acting later did not make the earlier closure harmless. I have spent seventeen years rehearsing explanations that end with me having no choice. I will not give you one of those. Ask me what I saw. If I do not know, make me say so.

samples.speaker: mara
samples.direction: Mara: mature archivist, tired but lucid, vulnerability beneath professional precision. Natural pauses, clear final words. About 130 words per minute.
samples.script: I thought you would understand the letter. Then I thought another letter would lead someone here. Each explanation made the next day of silence easier to justify. I frightened you because I was frightened, and because being useful felt safer than admitting I needed help. I can explain it. I cannot turn that explanation into something you owed me.
